clauses.evidence: E11-S01#AC1 (Statistics opens); Settings half in E12-S01#AC1
E11-S01#AC4 (forced fold excluded from point); core in E10-S05#AC7-8

findings.evidence: REQ-048.3 says the target line appears 'once 1,000 unhinted hands exist'; REQ-048.9 says 'once 1,000 hands exist'. E11-S06#AC4 (1,050 hands, 60 containing a hinted decision -> line drawn) picks the 048.9 reading; under 048.3 a hinted hand might not count.
findings.fix: Decide whether the 1,000-hand threshold counts all hands or only hands without a hinted decision; align 048.3 and 048.9, then adjust E11-S06#AC1/AC4.

findings.evidence: REQ-049.4 says 'After 5,000 unhinted hands' and sits under the 'current filter' screen. E11-S11 interprets it as 5,000 stored hands regardless of filter (AC1 uses 4,999 stored hands, AC2 '5,000 unhinted hands'); the requirement does not say whether hinted hands count toward 5,000 or whether the filter applies.
findings.fix: Clarify the 5,000 threshold (hands vs unhinted decisions) and whether the G-2 verdict ignores filters; then make E11-S11 ACs unambiguous.

findings.evidence: REQ-048.7 (fewer hands than one group -> 'Play <n> more hands') and REQ-048.10 (zero hands in filter -> 'Play your first hand to see trends.') both apply with zero hands on the default per-500 grouping. E11-S01#AC7 and E11-S08#AC4 show the 'Play 500 more hands' text; E11-S02#AC6 shows 'Play your first hand' only for per-session/per-day.
findings.fix: Confirm which message the default grouping shows with zero hands in the filter.

findings.evidence: REQ-048 charts 'all stored hands' but E11-S01#AC5 and its description invent a rule that the trailing incomplete 500-hand group (200 of 1,200 hands) is not plotted; no clause states this.
findings.fix: Confirm that only complete 500-hand groups are plotted (or that the partial tail is shown); add as a clause.

findings.evidence: E11-S04 description says BB/100 uses cash hands only and per-500 counts cash hands only, but no AC covers the game-type filter Sit-and-go (no cash hands) or the 'Play n more hands' message for the BB/100 chart when total hands >= 500 but cash hands < 500.
findings.fix: Add ACs for the BB/100 chart with zero cash hands and with fewer than 500 cash hands.

findings.evidence: Mechanical C5-AND warnings: E11-S03 (two filters), E11-S02 (three groupings), E11-S05 (average plus count). Each is one capability with tightly related ACs, so splitting is optional.
findings.fix: No change required; optionally split E11-S03 into table-size and game-type filter stories.

summary: All 19 clauses covered. Four user-owned ambiguities in REQ-048/049 thresholds and messages; ACs have exact values and are testable.
